---
title: "Supplemental Figure 5"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Generate Supplemental Figure 5, corresponding for Figure 5: HSPC 
human datasets supplementary.

This is a big supplementary figure supporting the blidn re-annotation of
human HSPC datasets and also contains info on the batch correction. 
Need to think carefully how to structure the text here so let's not do 
the figure toooo perfectly at first.

Instead of ordering by alphabet I will order by type of plot as ABC plot
part order may change later.

The corr_pval plot has instead been added to figure S4. 

#### Load objects

```{r seed, message = FALSE}
RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG") 
set.seed(37)
```

```{r load_packages, message = FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggpubr, quietly = TRUE)
library(tidyverse, quietly = TRUE)
```

# Batch UMAPs

Find a good way to visualise the batches using UMAPs in relatively small space.

I will make more plots than I eventually need so I know which ones are most useful
for the figure.
Not all of them will fit.

```{r theme_umaps_supp}
theme_umaps_supp <- ggplot2::theme(
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = supplementary_text_size,
      color = axis_text_color,
      face = axis_text_face
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = supplementary_text_size,
      color = axis_text_color,
      face = axis_text_face
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = supplementary_text_size,
      color = axis_text_color,
      face = axis_text_face
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = supplementary_text_size,
      color = axis_text_color,
      face = axis_text_face
    ),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm")
  )
```

## Dataset 1

The UMAP coordinates will be taken from the object that was reclustered with 
signature genes and then re-annotated, because that is the one showing batch effect best.

```{r prep_umap_o1}
# add all annotations together in one object
# the one containing the signature-based umap coordinates
seu_all_o1 <- seu_both_o1

# this is the same as was originally called "annotated_reclustered" in Fig5
# but for clarity here, will call it signature label
# reclustered and annotated using signature genes
head(seu_all_o1$signature_label)
head(seu_all_o1$annotated_reclustered)
identical(seu_all_o1$annotated_reclustered, seu_all_o1$signature_label)

# these are the labels obtained after batch correction, then reclustering
# and annotation, all using only signature genes
seu_all_o1$batchc_sign_labels <- vector(length = ncol(seu_all_o1))
seu_all_o1$batchc_sign_labels <- seu_batchcorrected_o1$batchc_sign_labels[
  match(
    colnames(seu_all_o1),
    colnames(seu_batchcorrected_o1))]
head(seu_all_o1$batchc_sign_labels)

# also the original annotation
head(seu_all_o1$cell_type)
```

```{r factor_umap_o1}

seu_all_o1$assay_factored  <- unfactor(seu_all_o1$assay)

seu_all_o1$assay_factored[which(seu_all_o1$assay_factored == "10x 5' transcription profiling")] <- "10x 5'"

seu_all_o1$assay_factored <- factor(
  seu_all_o1$assay_factored,
  levels = c(
    "10x 3' v3",
    "10x 5'",
    "Smart-seq2"))
```

```{r umap_batch_o1_cell_type_assay, fig.width = 8.25, fig.height = 2.5}

  dims = c(1,2), 
  group.by = "cell_type")+
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    nrow = 1,
    facets = vars(seu_all_o1$assay_factored))+
```

### Combine the selected plots

```{r, chosen_batch_umap_o1, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 6}

# col_anno_ts_bone_marrow from determine_params.R

chosen_umap_o1_a <- umap_batch_o1_signature_label_assay+
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    "Reclustered and annotated\nwith signature genes",
    values = col_anno_ts_bone_marrow[names(col_anno_ts_bone_marrow) %in% 
      seu_all_o1$signature_label])
chosen_umap_o1_b <- umap_batch_o1_batchc_sign_labels_assay+
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    "Batch corrected,\nreclustered and annotated\nwith signature genes",
    values = col_anno_ts_bone_marrow[names(col_anno_ts_bone_marrow) %in% 
      seu_all_o1$batchc_sign_labels])  

chosen_batch_umap_o1 <- ggpubr::ggarrange(
  chosen_umap_o1_a + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none"),
  chosen_umap_o1_b + ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank()),
  ncol = 1,
  align = "hv"
)
chosen_batch_umap_o1
```

```{r chosen_umap_o1_a_legend, fig.width = 3, fig.height = 3}

chosen_umap_o1_a_legend_theme <- ggpubr::get_legend(chosen_umap_o1_a)
chosen_umap_o1_a_legend <- ggpubr::ggarrange(chosen_umap_o1_a_legend_theme)
chosen_umap_o1_a_legend
```

```{r chosen_umap_o1_b_legend, fig.width = 3, fig.height = 3}

chosen_umap_o1_b_legend_theme <- ggpubr::get_legend(chosen_umap_o1_b)
chosen_umap_o1_b_legend <- ggpubr::ggarrange(chosen_umap_o1_b_legend_theme)
chosen_umap_o1_b_legend
```

# Heatmaps Batch correction

## Other Dataset 1

```{r mat_ct_bc_o1_anno}

mat_ct_bc_o1_anno <- base::table(
  seu_all_o1$cell_type, 
  seu_all_o1$batchc_sign_labels)

for(i in 1:ncol(mat_ct_bc_o1_anno)){
  mat_ct_bc_o1_anno[,i] <- mat_ct_bc_o1_anno[,i]/base::sum(mat_ct_bc_o1_anno[,i])
}
ct_bc_df_o1_anno <- base::as.data.frame(mat_ct_bc_o1_anno)

ct_bc_df_o1_anno$Var2 <- factor(
  ct_bc_df_o1_anno$Var2,
  levels = rev(levels(seu_all_o1$batchc_sign_labels)))

levels(ct_bc_df_o1_anno$Var1)

# for nicer visualisation/unified cell type naming scheme
ct_bc_df_o1_anno$Var1 <- unfactor(ct_bc_df_o1_anno$Var1)
ct_bc_df_o1_anno$Var1[
  ct_bc_df_o1_anno$Var1 == "hematopoietic stem cell"] <- "HSC"
```

# Threshold sliding

Now including reclustering of datasets using signature genes obtained from sliding
thresholds on nDGE and marker gene analysis.

From the report in 03/04/05

## Other dataset 1

### by p

```{r prep_df_by_p_o1}
score_df_all_by_p_o1 <- dplyr::bind_rows(scores_by_p_o1)
head(score_df_all_by_p_o1)

print(threshold_used_p)

score_df_all_by_p_o1$threshold_used <- -log10(as.numeric(
  score_df_all_by_p_o1$threshold_used))
threshold_by_p_plot <- -log10(as.numeric(threshold_used_p))
xtitle_by_p <- "-log10 (padj) nDEG"

score_df_all_by_p_o1[score_df_all_by_p_o1$threshold_used == threshold_by_p_plot,]
```

```{r threshold_by_p_base_o1}
threshold_by_p_base_o1 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  score_df_all_by_p_o1[score_df_all_by_p_o1$type %in% c(
    "adjusted_rand_index",
    "mean_prop_cells_cluster",
    "variation_information",
    "mean_cluster_purity"
  ),],
  aes(
    x = threshold_used,
    y = value,
    color = type))+
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.6)+
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = threshold_by_p_plot, color = "orangered")+
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual("score", values = col_scores)+
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 3.5),
    breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 3))
threshold_by_p_base_o1
```

```{r threshold_by_p_theme_o1}
threshold_by_p_theme_o1 <- threshold_by_p_base_o1+
  theme_all+
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = supplementary_text_size,
      color = axis_text_color
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = supplementary_text_size,
      color = axis_text_color
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = supplementary_text_size,
      color = axis_text_color
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = supplementary_text_size,
      color = axis_text_color
    ),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "grey80", 
      linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
  ggplot2::xlab(xtitle_by_p)
threshold_by_p_theme_o1
```

```{r threshold_by_t_theme_o1}
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "grey80", 
      linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
  ggplot2::xlab(xtitle_by_t)
threshold_by_t_theme_o1
```
